scope: Weeks 01-04 ke YouTube long videos aur YouTube/TikTok Shorts

license.label: Free for use under the Pixabay Content License
license.note: Track page ka screenshot ya PDF save karo. Yeh public-domain guarantee nahi hai; source page aur license evidence hamesha sambhal kar rakho. Content ID ya platform claim ka zero-risk promise koi source nahi deta.

youtube_audio_library.note: YouTube-only upload ke liye official Audio Library ka track bhi use ho sakta hai. TikTok par reuse karne se pehle us track ki license/attribution terms check karo.

download_steps: Neeche apne week ka exact Pixabay source page kholo.
Page par Free for use under the Pixabay Content License aur Free download check karo.
Free download par click karke MP3 save karo; temporary direct download URL share nahi kiya gaya, kyun ke woh expire ho sakta hai.
File ko neeche diye gaye filename se rename karo aur source page plus license page ka screenshot save karo.
CapCut mein Audio > Sounds/From device > imported MP3 se file add karo.

capcut_mix.long_video: Track chhota ho to duplicate/loop karo aur cuts ko sentence breaks par rakho.
capcut_mix.shorts: Shorts ke liye strongest 30-55 second section trim karo; YouTube Shorts aur TikTok dono mein same low bed use kar sakte ho.
capcut_mix.rule: Voice clear rehni chahiye; music sirf atmosphere ho, second speaker nahi.

weeks.video_title: They Called Him The Church Treasurer

track.title: Tense Crime Documentary Piano
track.review_note: Research check par Pixabay page ne Free for use under the Pixabay Content License dikhaya; Content ID Registered badge visible nahi tha. Upload se pehle page dobara check karna.

use_map.instruction: Low piano se opening account reveal start karo; 1:24 ke baad loop karo.
Deposit slip reveal par music ka first tense rise rakho.
Two ledgers explanation ke neeche steady section rakho; volume 5-7%.
Final question se pehle half-second pause, phir piano hit aur fade out.
